shared_or_similar_visual_information: Circular markers at boundaries of marked spans or plotted branches. Compare the upper marker at x = 1 in the left image with the marker at 7 on the number line in the right image.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The oblique branch excludes its x = 1 endpoint. Right image: The depicted right-side interval includes its left endpoint 7.
Rationales: The selected left cue excludes the indicated boundary point. The selected right cue includes the indicated boundary point, so the two constraints differ in how they admit values.
